$schema-comment: Per-file coverage floors enforced by scripts/check-coverage.mjs in CI. Each file lists the minimum percentage for lines/branches/functions; CI fails if actual coverage drops below any. Files not listed are tracked in coverage but not gated. Floors are set at roughly actual-minus-1pp to leave a small headroom for line-count noise on small files; raise them when adding tests, lower only with an explicit reason in the commit message.
